introHtml: Rainbow-colored household items bring a cheerful, inclusive energy to any home or office. From custom rainbow kitchen towels to multicolored aprons and reusable bags, these products create a memorable, feel-good brand impression. The rainbow palette works especially well for pride events, diversity initiatives, or any campaign that celebrates color and joy. Decorate with screen printing, embroidery, or full-color heat transfer for a crisp, long-lasting finish.
